name: RetireOnSol
long_description: RetireOnSol is a native Solana retirement planning app built for Seeker. It offers two modes: a simple Basic mode for quick projections, and a deep Advanced mode with four dedicated tabs for complete retirement planning. Basic mode lets you enter SOL holdings, monthly DCA, years until retirement, and desired income for instant Monte Carlo projections. Advanced mode includes GROW (four growth models, 500-path simulations, DCA scheduling), SPEND (drawdown simulations with success probability), MONITOR (live DCA tracking, wallet balance, push notifications), and LEADERBOARD (compete via Seeker ID). Connect via Seed Vault with native MWA. Features editable sliders, JitoSOL yield, biometric lock, price alerts, and shareable projections.
